scope: Selected official/primary sources, not full-paper reading. Publication years are unestablished unless stated; access date and SUNDIALS repository version are separate.

references.title: Stored official v7.1.1 IDA Robertson output
references.review_scope: Selected printed t=0.4 and4 values only, with Decimal rounding intervals. These approximate IDA values are not exact truth; no IDA run is performed here.

references.title: NIST DLMF section22.19(i), pendulum
references.review_scope: Selected pendulum formulas, phase and modulus convention. Authored Cartesian conversion uses K-t; SciPy takes parameter m=k². No full chapter reading claimed.

references.title: NIST DLMF section19.8(i), arithmetic-geometric mean
references.review_scope: Selected AGM/K identity; independent Decimal Machin pi and sine with explicit finite remainders qualify a single fixed modulus.
